content: For extracting shared document-level mousemove/mouseup/touchmove/touchend drag listeners in Angular, the common pattern is a dedicated injectable service (or directive) that owns bound handler references, exposes start/stop methods, and is called from ngOnDestroy for defensive cleanup; document-level listeners on mousemove/mouseup trigger Angular change detection app-wide so should be added only for the duration of the drag and removed immediately on drag-end, matching the existing boundOnRulerMove/boundOnRulerEnd pattern in this codebase.
